answer: Correlation penalties: the network keeps an atlas of agent behavior—timing, wording style, funding source—and when a grove of new accounts acts in lockstep, their shared rewards are cut in proportion to how similar they look. A lone honest agent on the tundra of the network loses nothing, but an attacker must pay to make each fake truly independent: separate funding, distinct work, staggered timing, which erases the profit of cloning.
